sources.entry: StackRender - Database schema design and SQL migration generator supporting PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, SQLite, SQL Server, and Oracle. (Demo, Source Code) AGPL-3.0 Nodejs/Docker

summary.one_liner: StackRender is a free, open-source database schema diagram designer that lets you visually build schemas and export them as SQL DDL for several database engines.
summary.what_it_does: The web app provides an interactive drag-and-drop diagram UI for designing database schemas. Users can customize tables, columns, types, and constraints. It offers index suggestions aimed at performance, and it can import existing SQL DDL or export a design as SQL scripts. Foreign key cycle detection flags circular relationships between tables. The README also describes an AI-powered assistant, but it is only offered in the cloud version, not the self-hosted build. Supported dialects listed are PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, SQLite, Oracle, and SQL Server.
use_cases: generate SQL DDL scripts for multiple databases
import existing SQL schema to a diagram
get index suggestions for database performance
convert a schema between SQL dialects
notable: Imports and exports SQL DDL across six database dialects
Optional cloud version with AI-assisted schema generation
caveats: AI assistant features are only in the cloud version
Local setup requires Node.js or Docker
